 At Jammu

sentences.text: Through: Mr. Bari Abdullah, Advocate.

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge
 Order

1. Sole respondent-Shakur Ali demised on 16.12.2010 about which fact the appellant was not aware and further at no point of time this fact was ever disclosed only coming to be known when an application CM No. 2475/2024 came to be filed on 04.05.2024 by the legal representatives of the sole respondent-Shakur Ali thereby seeking their impleadment.
2. For the reasons stated in the application coupled with the submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant, the same is allowed.

3. Legal representatives so named in the application are (i) Mubarak Ali (son), (ii) Gulshar Ali (son),
(iii) Shafayat Ali (son).
The said three legal representatives are hereby brought on record to represent deceased respondent- Shakur Ali.
4. Application CM No. 2475/2024 stands disposed of.

sentences.text: 5. Registry to reflect the names of said three legal representatives of the respondent-Shakur Ali in the cause title of the appeal.

6. Heard learned counsel for the appellant and also for the legal representatives of the sole deceased respondent-Shakur Ali.
7.

This is an appeal under section 52 of the Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990 whereby an award dated 31.12.2007 passed by the Additional District Judge, Ramban in a reference on file No. 01/Reference of 2004 has been questioned.

entities.text: Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 8. The deceased respondent-Shakur Ali's land measuring 12.17 kanals in khasra No. 106 min situated in mauza Kunfer, Chanderkote, tehsil Ramban came to be acquired under the J&K Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990 in terms of land acquisition award No. 666-71/ACQ dated 27.02.2004, in terms whereof the rate of compensation payable for different kinds of land came to be proposed and the same are reproduced herein under:
1. For Hail type of land.

For W. Changi/W. Mandi type of land = Rs. 50,000/-
3.

For Banjar Jadid type of land = Rs. 30,000/-
4.

For Gair Mumkin type of land = Rs. 10,000/-
9.

For the aforesaid land of the respondent-Shakur Ali (now deceased), the compensation assessed in terms of the award so passed by the Collector, Land Acquisition, Doda came to be Rs. 4,22,297/-
and also compensation for non-fruit bearing trees along with solatium @ 15%.

10. The compensation so assessed payable in favour of the respondent- Shakur Ali was on the basis of the assessment of the compensation rate for banjar jadid @ Rs. 30,000/- per kanal and for gair mumkin bana Rs. 10,000/- per kanal.
The deceased respondent-Shakur Ali' land measuring 12.17 kanals comprised of 11.17 kanals as banjar jadid and one kanal as gair mumkin bana.

11. Aggrieved of the award so passed, the respondent-Shakur Ali (now deceased) has sought a reference which came to be answered by the Additional District Judge, Ramban on file No.
01/Reference by directing that the land of the respondent-Shakur Ali measuring 11.17 kanals as banjar jadid should have been treated as warhal changi/hail thereby admitting of compensation @
Rs. 1,00,000/- per kanal whereas, with respect to assessment of compensation for 1 kanal of gair mumkin bana, rate of Rs. 10,000/- per kanal was correct assessment.

12. Thus, with respect to his 11.17 kanals of land, though banjar jadid in nature, the deceased respondent-Shakur Ali came to have enhancement of compensation from Rs. 30,000/- per kanal to Rs. 1,00,000/- per kanal thereby totaling the compensation payable in favour of the deceased-respondent-Shakur Ali to be Rs. 13,76,163/-.

It is pertinent to mention here that the State Of J&K Through Collector vs Shakur Ali on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/87385587/
2 acquisition was for the purpose of Baglihar Hydro Electric Project, Chanderkote.

sentences.text:
13. Learned counsel for the legal representatives of the deceased respondent-Shakur Ali has brought to the attention of this Court that for the same very project related land acquisition, this Court in the case of "J&K State Power Development Corporation and others Vs. Mohd. Basharat and others"
reported in 2017 (3) JKJ 101 came to uphold the enhancement of compensation awarded by the same very court of the Additional District Judge, Ramban.

entities.text: J&K State Power Development Corporation and others Vs. Mohd. Basharat and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 14. This Court has gone through the reported judgment and the principle invoked by this Court in upholding the enhancement.

Same very judgment holds good for the present case and, accordingly,
the appeal filed by the appellant is dismissed by upholding the award 31.12.2007 so passed by the Additional District Judge, Ramban filed No. 01/Reference.
15.

In terms of the order dated 05.05.2008, the appellant was directed to deposit 50% of the enhanced amount of compensation and, accordingly, an amount of Rs. 3,89,004/- came to be deposited as is born out from the office noting dated 10.06.2008 and the rest of the enhanced compensation amount is to be deposited by the appellant with the Collector Land Acquisition, Doda.

16. Since Rs. 3,89,004/- as being 50% of the enhanced amount came to be deposited with this Court which has been kept in FDR and that has earned interest thereupon and, accordingly, the rest of 50% amount to be deposited by the appellant with the Collector Land Acquisition, Doda which shall be bearing the same return of interest amount for which the Account Section of this Court shall be notifying it on the file for the sake of deposit of the rest of the enhanced amount by the appellant with the Collector Land Acquisition, Doda.
Requisite deposit to be made within a period of three months.
17. Deposited amount of Rs. 3,89,004/- along with accrued interest lying with this Court to be remitted by the Registrar Judicial, Jammu to the Collector Land Acquisition, Doda for its disbursement.

18. Upon the deposit of the rest of the enhanced compensation amount, the three legal representatives as named herein before shall be entitled to seek withdrawal in equal shares subject to their identification and furnishing of an individual undertaking that in the event of any other better claimant/legal heir, claiming under the deceased respondent-Shakur Ali, coming forward and staking a better claim before this Court, then the said three legal representatives, individually as well as collectively, shall be bound to act in compliance to any direction as may be passed by this Court with respect to the amount of compensation as may get withdrawn by them pursuant to this judgment.
19. Disposed of.
(RAHUL BHARTI) JUDGE JAMMU 09.07.2024
